results.title: How to Make a Prototype That Brings Your App Idea to Life | RapidNative
results.snippet: A prototype’s job isn't to be the final product; it's to validate the core idea as quickly and cheaply as possible. You have to be ruthless with your prioritization. Just ask yourself one question: "What is the absolute bare minimum a user needs to test my core concept?" For our fitness app, logging a workout is essential. Viewing a complex, multi-year progress chart? Definitely not. Adding friends is a "nice-to-have," but a functional dashboard is a "must-have."
